national_news.title: Digital Self-Enumeration for Census 2027 Commences in Ladakh
bullets: Ladakh will be the first Union Territory to complete the Census 2027 exercise.
Self-enumeration runs from 17 Aug to 31 Aug, followed by population enumeration from 1 Sep to 30 Sep.
A total of 637 Enumeration Blocks (EBs) have been created for the exercise.

national_news.title: India to Host 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi
bullets: The meeting, scheduled for tomorrow, will be preceded by the BRICS Senior Officers’ Meeting of the Environment Working Group and Contact Group on Climate Change and Sustainable Development.
It will be held under the theme of India’s BRICS Chairship 2026 – Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.
Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav will preside over the event.

national_news.title: National Anubhav Awards 2026 Conferred by MoS Dr Jitendra Singh in New Delhi
bullets: MoS Dr Jitendra Singh conferred the National Anubhav Awards 2026 in New Delhi.
The event saw the release of the Handbook on Pension Mitra and Guidelines for the National-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign‑Five.
A Bank Exhibition featuring 17 Pension Disbursing Banks showcased products and services tailored for retiring employees.

national_news.title: Ukraine and Russia exchange missile and drone strikes, 11 casualties each side
bullets: Ukraine launched over 150 drones targeting Russia, killing six people and damaging homes and a railway station.
Russia’s southwestern Rostov region suffered five casualties from drone attacks on three towns.
The strikes caused a forest fire and an 83‑year‑old man was killed in the Moscow region by a Ukrainian drone.

national_news.title: Indonesia Declares 14‑Day Emergency Response Period After 7.7‑Magnitude Earthquake
bullets: East Nusa Tenggara Governor Melki Laka Lena declared a 14‑day emergency response period following a 7.7‑magnitude earthquake off Flores.
The emergency measures aim to facilitate disaster response, evacuations, relief distribution and recovery efforts in the affected areas.
The quake and 341 aftershocks caused 51 deaths and 113 injuries.

national_news.title: BWF Badminton World Championships to Begin in New Delhi
bullets: The championships will be held at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, marking a major international sporting event in India.
Indian shuttlers such as P.V. Sindhu, Treesa Jolly, Gayatri Gopichand, and Ayush Shetty will compete in the opening rounds.
The event highlights India's growing prominence in badminton and provides a platform for athletes to showcase their talent on a global stage.

national_news.title: India Draw 2-2 With China in FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup Opener
bullets: India’s women’s hockey team secured a 2-2 draw against China in the opening match of the FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup.
Navneet opened the scoring, Deepika added a penalty‑corner goal, while China equalised through penalty strokes by Zhang Ying and Ma Ning.
The match was played at Amstelveen, Netherlands, marking India’s first encounter in the tournament.

national_news.title: Magnus Carlsen Wins Esports World Cup Chess Title for Second Consecutive Year
bullets: Carlsen remained undefeated throughout the tournament, securing his second consecutive Esports World Cup title.
The championship was held in Paris, France, featuring a best‑of‑three sets format with each of the first two sets comprising four games.
The event highlighted the growing prominence of esports and competitive chess on the global stage.

national_news.title: FPIs Invest ₹16,621 Crore in Indian Equities in August
bullets: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) were net buyers, investing ₹16,621 crore in the domestic market during the first two weeks of August 2026.
Breakdown of investment: ₹11,199 crore through stock‑exchange purchases and ₹5,422 crore via the primary market.
The buying momentum, which accelerated in July, continues, driven by resilient domestic fundamentals and strong quarterly earnings.
